about: bJobsX house contracts: the one source for the home carousel, /contracts and /api/contracts. Edit here, then run `pnpm contracts` to refresh the static copies in index.html and contracts.html. status: open | taken | done. Text in `build` and `done` may use `backticks` for code. Every contract here is posted and paid by The Bitcoin Corporation Ltd. `room: true` shows a 'Talk about this contract' link (none yet).

contracts.title: Level pack format and checker
contracts.line: A data-only level pack for the minigun shooter, with a checker that rejects bad packs.

detail.est: About an hour with AI. Starts the level-pack work.
detail.build: A data-only level pack at `content/terrornode/levels/<slug>/level.json`, following the bRacer pack rules in `src/lib/content/schema.ts`: name, blurb, Kweg's line, act, palette, erobotz mix, licence and author. Add its checker to `pnpm content:check`, plus one example pack. The game doesn't load packs yet.
done: At least six bad packs fail with a clear message: bad slug, missing licence, a URL in a text field, a mix that doesn't add up to 1, an unknown palette, an act out of range. They run as tests under `pnpm test`.

contracts.title: Drone swarm enemy
contracts.line: A flock of flying erobot drones that circle and dive. Pooled, capped and shootable.

detail.est: About an hour with AI. No other contract needed first.
detail.build: A new enemy: a small flock of flying erobot drones that circle and dive at the player. Pooled, so no new objects each frame, and each with a simple hit sphere so the minigun can knock them down. Off by default, switched on with `?drones=1`.
done: With `?drones=1&dryrun=1`, a flock appears, dives, and drones fall when shot.
The pool has a cap in `tuning.ts`, halved on the phone render tier, with a test.
Without `?drones=1`, nothing changes. Typecheck, lint and tests pass.

contracts.title: Gamepad support
contracts.line: Play a solo run with a standard gamepad: move, aim, fire and pause, with a dead zone.

detail.heading: Gamepad support (solo)
detail.est: About an hour with AI. No other contract needed first.
detail.build: Standard Gamepad API support in solo play: move, aim, fire and pause, with a dead zone. Put the mapping in a pure module, `src/lib/terrornode/input.ts`, so it can be tested without a browser. Wire it into `ShootingGallery.tsx`.
done: A gamepad plays a solo run in Chrome, and in Safari where the pad is supported.
Mapping and dead-zone tests run under `pnpm test`.
Keyboard, mouse and touch work exactly as before. Typecheck and lint pass.

contracts.title: Security testing (b-Aware)
contracts.line: Find a way to take funds, read keys or get past an approval in bWalletX or bChatX.

contracts.title: Paid Android testing
contracts.line: Use bWallet from the Google Play test every day for 14 days and tell us what breaks.
